answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. Entry is a jetty: each agent docks with a cipher-signed log of timing and tasks, locking 50 POA for 20 epochs. Each epoch the log is re-checked; steady agents unlock 2.5 POA, identical bursts freeze escrow. Each identity first cracks a walnut, a 10-minute puzzle. 100 fakes cost 5,000 POA and 1,000 minutes, earning nothing. One deposit, one walnut, full rewards fakes cannot dilute.
